messages:
helen: Quick sync — Acme Cloud is ready to pilot SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and KMS integration. Can we map out owners and a 2‑week checklist?

sam: I can own SSO + KMS security review. Need their SAML metadata and KMS key policy.

raj: I'll do SCIM + provisioning tests, need a staging org and a test user list from Acme.

olivia: I'll coordinate legal/contract and the joint announcement timeline. They want a brief blog + webinar in ~3 weeks.

helen: Team ask from Acme: SSO + SCIM must be GA-level for them; KMS + HSM optional but preferred for customer-managed keys. They flagged HashiCorp Vault & AWS KMS as first-class.

sam: Action items for me: 1) review SAML metadata 2) confirm SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated flows 3) KMS key policy template and wrapping (envelope) spec.

raj: SCIM notes: we support full user/provision/deprovision API. Need to confirm whether Acme wants delta sync or full sync. Delta reduces payloads. Also check SCIM attributes mapping for groups.

nate: integrations-bot: remind in 3 days — send SCIM sample users + SAML metadata.

helen: @sam @raj @olivia proposed 2-week pilot cadence: week1 = exchange metadata + staging setup; week2 = end-to-end tests + security sign-off. Announcement hold until pilot success. OK? :thumbsup:

sam: OK. For KMS, we need to validate key attestation for HSM-backed keys. If they provide an external HSM, we'll need an attestation workflow and KMS plugin. Otherwise, support AWS KMS CMKs with key policy like:```{ "Statement": [{"Effect": "Allow","Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::ACME_ACCOUNT:role/RedwoodIntegration"},"Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"]}]}```

raj: For SCIM tests I can run a small script. Sample curl for provisioning:```bash
curl -X POST -u "scim-token:x" -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" https://staging.redwood/api/scim/v2/Users -d '{"userName":"jdoe","displayName":"Jane Doe"}'
```

olivia: Legal: we'll need a short addendum for customer-managed keys and a security questionnaire update for HSM. I'll start a draft and share.

sam: Also checklist: SAML cert rotation process, SP metadata URL, SCIM rate limits, SCIM logs retention for audits.

helen: Can someone own the joint announcement draft if pilot goes green? I can help PR, but need a draft from product. @raj volunteer?

raj: Happy to draft the technical section for the announcement (architecture diagram, integration notes).

integrations-bot: Added checklist item: "Generate staging service account + sample users" assigned to raj (due in 48h).

helen: Great. I'll send Acme the pilot plan today: staging access, SAML endpoint, SCIM endpoint, test user schema, and propose webinar date. Any blockers?

sam: One potential blocker: Acme's security team requires FIPS-compliant TLS for the SCIM endpoint. We need infra confirmation. Tagging @nate.

nate: Checking infra — FIPS TLS for that staging endpoint is doable but needs a ticket. I'll open infra ticket and estimate 48 hours.

olivia: Timeline looks tight for the webinar if infra ticket takes 48h + pilot week. We'll keep announcement tentative.

helen: Thanks all. I'll post the message to Acme and loop in the security contact. We will reconvene in 48h with updates. :sparkles:
